model_contract.acceptance: The finite premise and failed conclusion are recomputed from the serialized adjacency certificate by a same-executor replay. This is a consistency check, not independent verification.
model_contract.conclusion: cc(G) <= 2 cp(G), where cp is maximum vertex-disjoint cycle packing and cc is minimum feedback vertex set
model_contract.counterexample: G is a finite simple planar graph and NOT (cc(G) <= 2 cp(G), where cp is maximum vertex-disjoint cycle packing and cc is minimum feedback vertex set)
model_contract.limitations: No candidate in a finite corpus is not a proof of the unbounded claim.
model_contract.objects: finite simple graphs, with any auxiliary finite data stated below
model_contract.premise: G is a finite simple planar graph
model_contract.source_statement: For every planar graph G, cc(G) <= 2 cp(G), where cp(G) is the maximum number of vertex-disjoint cycles and cc(G) is the minimum size of a vertex set whose deletion makes G acyclic.
